verdict.rationale: The only evidence of API versioning is the "Upload API (V2)" label in Synthesia's API reference introduction, so versioned endpoints exist. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or a broader versioning scheme across the Video, Localization and Billing APIs. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, explicit versioning scheme across all APIs, changelog or sunset notices, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
